    bad=[]
    for I,out,bg,mk,sep,name in [(I1,out1g,0,3,9,'D1'),(I2,out2g,3,5,6,'D2'),(I3,out3,7,5,2,'D3'),(I4,out4,5,8,7,'D4')]:

def check_R2(I,out,bg,mkc,sep,name):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    rsep=[r for r in range(H) if all(v==sep for v in I[r])]
    csep=[c for c in range(W) if all(I[r][c]==sep for r in range(H))]
    rb=[(s,e) for s,e in zip([0]+[r+1 for r in rsep],[r for r in rsep]+[H])]
    cb=[(s,e) for s,e in zip([0]+[c+1 for c in csep],[c for c in csep]+[W])]
    bad=[]
    for bi,(rs,re) in enumerate(rb):
        for bj,(cs,ce) in enumerate(cb):
            g=[(r,c) for r in range(rs,re) for c in range(cs,ce) if I[r][c]==mkc]
            exp=0 if out[bi][bj]==bg else 1
            if len(g)>=2:
                onframe = all(c in (0,W-1) for r,c in g) or all(r in (0,H-1) for r,c in g)
                adj = len(g)==2 and abs(g[0][0]-g[1][0])+abs(g[0][1]-g[1][1])==1
                pred = 0 if (onframe and adj) else 1
                if pred!=exp: bad.append((name,(bi,bj),g,'onframe',onframe,'adj',adj,'exp',exp))
            elif exp!=0: bad.append((name,(bi,bj),'SINGLE',g))
    return bad

def tiles(I,sep):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])

def predict_R7(I,bg,mkc,sep):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); rb,cb=tiles(I,sep); out=[]
    for rs,re in rb:
        rowo=[]
        for cs,ce in cb:
            g=[(r,c) for r in range(rs,re) for c in range(cs,ce) if I[r][c]==mkc]
            if len(g)==2:
                (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=g
                adj=abs(r1-r2)+abs(c1-c2)==1
                fcol=any(c in (0,W-1) for _,c in g)
                top=(min(r1,r2))/H < 0.3
                rowo.append(0 if (adj and fcol and top) else (1 if len(g)==2 else bg))
            else: rowo.append(bg if len(g)<2 else 1)
        out.append(rowo)
    return out

import itertools
DEM6=(I6,out6,0,6,4)
ALLD=[('D1',I1,out1g,0,3,9),('D2',I2,out2g,3,5,6),('D3',I3,out3,7,5,9),('D4',I4,out4,5,8,7),('D5',I5,out5,8,7,6),('D6',I6,out6,0,6,4)]
def tiles2(I,sep):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    rs=[r for r in range(H) if all(v==sep for v in I[r])]
    cs=[c for c in range(W) if all(I[r][c]==sep for r in range(H))]
    def bands(seps,n):
        b=[];s=0
        for x in seps+[n]: 
            if x>s or x==n: b.append((s,x)); s=x+1
        return [t for t in b if t[0]<t[1]] if False else b[:-1]
    rb=[];s=0
    for r in rs+[H]:
        if r>s: rb.append((s,r))
        s=r+1
    cb=[];s=0
    for c in cs+[W]:
        if c>s: cb.append((s,c))
        s=c+1
    return rb,cb
def feats_pair(I,out,bgc,mkc,sep,trow,tcol):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0]); rb,cb=tiles2(I,sep)
    rs,re=rb[trow]; cs,ce=cb[tcol]
    g=[(r,c) for r in range(rs,re) for c in range(cs,ce) if I[r][c]==mkc]
    n=len(g)
    bh,bw=re-rs,ce-cs
    exp=out[trow][tcol]
    f={}
    if n==2:
        (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=g
        dr,dcr=abs(r1-r2),abs(c1-c2)
        man=dr+dcr
        f['vert']=dr>0 and dcr==0; f['horiz']=dr==0 and dcr>0
        f['adj']=man==1; f['dr1']=dr==1; f['dr2']=dr==2; f['dr3']=dr==3
        f['dc1']=dcr==1; f['dc2']=dcr==2
        f['onf_r']=any(r in(0,H-1) for r,_ in g); f['onf_c']=any(c in(0,W-1) for _,c in g)
        f['onf_cL']=any(c==0 for _,c in g); f['onf_cR']=any(c==W-1 for _,c in g)
        f['upper']=min(r1,r2)/H<0.34; f['lower']=max(r1,r2)/H>0.66
        f['top2']=all(rr_-rs<2 for rr_,_ in g); f['bot2']=all(re-1-rr_<2 for rr_,_ in g)
        f['lmin0']=min(r1,r2)==rs; f['lmaxe']=max(r1,r2)==re-1
        f['touchf_c']=f['onf_c']; f['bh3']=bh==3; f['bh4']=bh==4; f['bh5']=bh>=5
        f['corner']=any(r in(0,H-1) and c in(0,W-1) for r,c in g)
        f['samec']=c1==c2; f['samer']=r1==r2
    return n,g,exp,f,bh,bw,H,W,(rs,cs)
P=[]
for nm,I,out,bgc,mkc,sep in ALLD:
    rb,cb=tiles2(I,sep)
    for i,(rs,re) in enumerate(rb):
        for j,(cs,ce) in enumerate(cb):
            n,g,exp,f,bh,bw,H,W,rc=feats_pair(I,out,bgc,mkc,sep,i,j)
            if n>=2:
                f['n2']=n==2; f['n3']=n>=3; P.append((nm,(i,j),exp,f))
print('demo pair count:',len(P),'negatives:',[(nm,t) for nm,t,e,f in P if e==0])
# test tiles
rb,cb=tiles2(test,0); T=[]
for i,(rs,re) in enumerate(rb):
    for j,(cs,ce) in enumerate(cb):
        g=[(r,c) for r in range(rs,re) for c in range(cs,ce) if test[r][c]==8]
        f={}
        if len(g)==2:
            (r1,c1),(r2,c2)=g; dr,dcr=abs(r1-r2),abs(c1-c2); man=dr+dcr
            f['vert']=dcr==0 and dr>0; f['horiz']=dr==0; f['adj']=man==1
            f['dr1']=dr==1;f['dr2']=dr==2;f['dr3']=dr==3; f['dc1']=dcr==1;f['dc2']=dcr==2
            f['onf_r']=any(r in(0,13) for r,_ in g); f['onf_c']=any(c in(0,13) for _,c in g)
            f['onf_cL']=any(c==0 for _,c in g); f['onf_cR']=any(c==13 for _,c in g)
            f['upper']=min(r1,r2)/14<0.34; f['lower']=max(r1,r2)/14>0.66
            f['top2']=all(r-rs<2 for r,_ in g); f['bot2']=all(re-1-r<2 for r,_ in g)
            f['lmin0']=min(r1,r2)==rs; f['lmaxe']=max(r1,r2)==re-1
            f['bh3']=False; f['bh4']=True; f['bh5']=False
            f['corner']=any(r in(0,13) and c in(0,13) for r,c in g)
            f['samec']=c1==c2; f['samer']=r1==r2
            T.append(((i,j),len(g),f))
        else: T.append(((i,j),len(g),None))
print('test 2-marker tiles:',[(t,[(k) for k,v in f.items() if v]) for t,n,f in T if n==2])
